title: Holiday Specials|Downtown Nashville Gem|Free WIFI
description:
Stylish 1-bedroom luxury suite located in the heart of downtown just a short walk to Broadway, live music, world-class dining, and all the city’s hottest attractions. 

0.2 miles from Music City Center ﻿﻿
0.4 miles from Bridgestone Arena ﻿﻿
0.4 miles from Country Music HOF 
﻿﻿0.7 miles from Broadway ﻿﻿
1.3 miles from Nissan Stadium ﻿﻿
6.8 miles from Nashville BNA Airport 

Amenities includes a pool, outdoor grills, and a 24-hour gym. For added convenience, parking is available for $35/night.

The space
Designed for both comfort and style, the suite easily accommodates up to 5 guests with:

Queen bed in the private bedroom
Queen bed in the living room
Full convertible sofa sleeper in the living room 

Kitchen fully equipped with full essentials.

Smart TVs in both the living room and bedroom giving you the access to stream on your favorite apps!

Private balcony with seating and a table.

Guest access
Guests have access to a full one bedroom suite.

Guests have access to all of the property's amenities. This property operates with Latch Smart Lock System across the entire property. 

Guests will be set up with Latch upon booking.

Other things to note
Permit Number#2018071634.

Check-in/Check-out:
★Check-in is at 3 PM and Check-out is at 11 AM.

The concierge is at the lobby desk to help with questions about the community, Latch, and parking.

Concierge Hours: 2:00 pm to 10:00 pm, Wednesday through Sunday.

An overnight concierge is available from 10:00 pm to 6:00 am for nuisance complaints only.
